//: Discussion on how to write comments in package.json:
name: waxlens-monorepo

scripts.check: pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate && pnpm --filter @waxlens/core check && pnpm --filter @waxlens/protocol check && pnpm --filter @waxlens/daemon check && pnpm --filter @waxlens/tui check

//@types/node: interface augmentation — without it the VSCode TS LSP reports `Property
'dirname' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'`. pnpm's default hoisting is
per-workspace, so @types/node already declared in packages/*/package.json
is NOT visible from the monorepo root; it must be a direct devDependency
here so a symlink lands at <root>/node_modules/@types/node.
